espn-603993.headline: Argentina bring everyone. Ireland count the absentees
beats: Felipe Contepomi has named his strongest roster of the year. Captain Julián Montoya is back, with over a dozen others who missed the home games against Australia in late summer. Those produced a 27–21 defeat and a 28–28 draw.

Ireland are heading the other way. Caelan Doris and Jack Conan are both out for November, and Sam Prendergast is a doubt with a wrist injury picked up in training. Ireland's last Test was a 40–21 defeat in New Zealand in July.
Argentina's only win this year came against Wales in July, 35–21. A win in Dublin by 16 or more would lift them to seventh in the world and drop Ireland below France to fourth.
Both sides then play the bottom two, still without a point: Ireland host Fiji and Argentina go to Italy. The table is decided here.

espn-603994.headline: Top of the world, unless Italy remember March
beats: South Africa are first in the world rankings and first on the Nations Championship log, level on points with New Zealand. Italy have not won since beating England 23–18 at home in March.
Italy's July away tour conceded 27, 47 and 57. The 57 came against Australia, who are also the last side to beat South Africa, 42–38 in September.

Even a draw drops South Africa to second, below New Zealand. Rassie Erasmus already has a key player ruled out for Italy, France and Ireland, and Andre Esterhuizen limped off after 52 seconds for the Sharks against Cardiff.
Italy lost 32–14 at home to South Africa last November. France away comes next for South Africa, which is no fixture to take on in second.

espn-603995.headline: Scotland's Dunedin rehearsal starts at Murrayfield
beats: Scotland will play New Zealand in Dunedin next year, their last match before the World Cup and their first in New Zealand since 2000. They lost that one 48–14 at Eden Park. This is the home leg of the rehearsal.

The home leg went 17–25 last November. Since then New Zealand lost three straight to South Africa, then put 50 and 43 on Australia in October. Scotland scored 50 against France and 47 against Argentina this year, and let in 40 and 38 doing it.
New Zealand travel with an injury list that grew by three in late October. Win, and Scotland pass England into fifth in the world.
Beat New Zealand here, and Dunedin starts to look like a fixture rather than a sentence.

espn-603996.headline: Wales won by a point. Japan have since passed them
beats: Their last meeting, on 15 November 2025, went 24–23 to Wales at home, settled by Evans' last-second penalty that ended a 10-match home losing streak. Japan then won the Pacific Nations Cup in September, edging Fiji 20–15, and now sit two places above Wales in the rankings.
Wales have not played since July, when South Africa beat them 43–0 and they did not score a try. Japan have played since then, and lost at home to Fiji in October despite scoring four tries.
One point separates them in the Nations Championship as well. Lose this, and Wales drop below Italy, who have yet to win a game in it, to 12th at best.
The reward for winning is New Zealand at home a week later. For Japan it is England away.
